name: Vivienne Gaultier
source:
The lively, energetic Vivienne Gaultier has a lovely heart to match her vivid beauty. She adores her husband Vincent and cares deeply for their teenaged son, but the Viscountess also appears to be a little desperate for attention.

Despite her dedication to the Viscount, Vivienne seems to enjoy flirting with Julien–though her husband apparently takes no notice of her coquettish behavior.

[From the [url=https://mordred-f.jimdo.com/]official site[/url]]
